record.issue_text: update/destroy with a nonexistent id call save_host(nil) / nil.destroy in Admin::EmbeddableHostsController, causing reachable 500s

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update`, the record is fetched with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally passed to `save_host(host)`. If no record exists, `host` is `nil` and `save_host` calls `host.host = ...` / `host.category_id = ...`, raising `NoMethodError` (500). Similarly, `#destroy` does `host = ...first` and then `host.destroy` without a nil check, so a nonexistent id will call `nil.destroy` and 500.
